hints.title: Digit Occurrence Balance
hints.text: A number is balanced if every unique digit appears with frequency equal to its value.

hints.title: Bounded Candidate Space
hints.text: Because n is at most one million, the next balanced candidate will have at most seven digits.

hints.title: Incremental Testing
hints.text: Check numbers incrementally starting from n plus one by counting digit occurrences.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: K: difference to next balanced number
complexity.notes: Since n <= 10^6, the next balanced number is strictly bounded below 1224444.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all permutations without digit sum checks is unnecessarily complex.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Direct increment verification takes minimal steps due to dense balanced numbers.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should determine that checking candidates linearly is fast and bounded.
